test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the main significance of sustainable development?

options.text: Resources are unlimited and can be used greedily for our own needs
Preserve the natural resources for the needs of the future generation
Increases the cost of available natural resources
Indiscriminately exploits the available resources for rapid development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Preserve the natural resources for the needs of the future generation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sustainable development** aims to balance the fulfillment of human needs with the protection of the natural environment.
 
• It ensures that natural resources are available for future generations by promoting responsible and efficient use.
 
• The concept emphasizes the importance of **intergenerational equity**, which means that the current generation should meet its needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs.
 
• Sustainable development also involves the integration of **economic, social, and environmental policies** to create a more stable and equitable society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The concept of sustainable development was popularized by the **Brundtland Report** in 1987, which defined it as "development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs."
 
• Sustainable development is a **key principle** in international environmental agreements and policies, including the **United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• There are **17 SDGs** that address global challenges such as poverty, inequality, climate change, environmental degradation, and peace and justice, with the aim of achieving a better and more sustainable future for all by 2030.
 
• Businesses, governments, and individuals all have roles to play in promoting sustainable development through practices such as **reducing waste, conserving energy, and supporting sustainable products and services**.
